structured.answer: The big equity tracks are basically tied over 5 years (כלל תמר מניות 12.34%/yr, הראל מניות 12.41%/yr, both ~0.5% fee on assets), so there's no real money to gain by switching. The number to check against my own fund is the ~0.5% asset fee, not the return.
